name: Every match offers at least three bookmaker lines
description: The Odds tab is a comparison surface, so each match must carry at least three distinct bookmakers with full home/draw/away decimal odds. Fewer than three books, or duplicate book entries padding the count, means the comparison feature is not really built.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and read the ids of at least three distinct matches
For each id, navigate to /match-odds/<id>.json and read the books array

Verify each sampled match's artifact contains at least three books with distinct bookmaker names, and each book has decimal odds greater than 1.0 for home, draw and away. A match with fewer than three books, repeated book names, or any decimal odds at or below 1.0 fails.
